Surely, You command and are not commanded, and none whom You have committed to Your care shall be humiliated [and none whom You have taken as an enemy shall taste glory]. You are Blessed, Our Lord, and Exalted.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad, Ad-Darimi, Al-Hakim, 
and Al-Bayhaqi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/144, Sahih Ibn 
Majah 1/194, and 'Irwa'ul-GhaW. 2/ 172.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَعـوذُ بِرِضـاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِـك، وَبِمُعـافاتِـكَ مِنْ عُقوبَـتِك، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْـك، لا أُحْصـي ثَنـاءً عَلَـيْك، أَنْـتَ كَمـا أَثْنَـيْتَ عَلـى نَفْسـِك
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge with Your Pleasure from Your anger. I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises, You are as You have praised Yourself.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad. See Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 3/180, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil. 2/ 175.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِيّـاكَ نعْـبُدْ، وَلَـكَ نُصَلّـي وَنَسْـجُد، وَإِلَـيْكَ نَسْـعى وَنَحْـفِد، نَـرْجو رَحْمَـتَك، وَنَخْشـى عَـذابَك، إِنَّ عَـذابَكَ بالكـافرين ملْحَـق. اللّهُـمَّ إِنّا نَسْتَعـينُكَ وَنَسْتَـغْفِرُك، وَنُثْـنـي عَلَـيْك الخَـيْرَ، وَلا نَكْـفُرُك، وَنُـؤْمِنُ بِك، وَنَخْـضَعُ لَكَ وَنَخْـلَعُ مَنْ يَكْـفرُك
duas.en: O Allah, You alone do we worship, and to You we pray and bow down prostrate. To You we hasten to worship and to serve. Our hope is for Your mercy, and we fear Your punishment. Surely, Your punishment of the disbelievers is at hand. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, and we praise You beneficently. We do not deny You and we believe in You. We surrender to You and renounce whoever disbelieves in You.
duas.reference:
Al-Bayhaqi graded its chain authentic in As-Sunan Al-Kubra. Al-Albani said 
in 'Irwa'ul-GhaliL 2/170 that its chain is authentic as a statement of 
'Umar.

duas.book_name_en: Immediately after salam of the witr prayer
duas.ar: "سبحان الملك القدوس" ثلاث مرات والثالثة يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته "ربِّ الملائكةِ والرّوح"
duas.en: Glory is to the King, the Holy. [Recite three times in Arabic, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
duas.reference:
An-Nasa'i 3/244, Ad-Daraqutni and others. The final addition is from 
Ad-Daraqutni's version 2/ 31 and its chain of narration is authentic. See 
the checking of Zadul-Ma'ad by Shu'aib Al-Arna'ut and 'Abdul-Qadir 
Al-Arna'ut 1/337.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّي عَبْـدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْـدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِـكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَـدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤكَ أَسْأَلُـكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّـيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أِوْ أَنْزَلْتَـهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْـتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِـكَ أَوِ اسْتَـأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْـبِ عِنْـدَكَ أَنْ تَجْـعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيـعَ قَلْبِـي وَنورَ صَـدْرِي وجَلَاءَ حُـزْنِي وذَهَابَ هَمِّـي
duas.en: O Allah, I am Your slave, and the son of Your male slave, and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. you have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured, and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation, or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness, and the reliever of my distress.
duas.reference: Ahmad 1/391, and Al-Albani graded it authentic.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَعْوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَـمِّ وَ الْحُـزْنِ، والعًجْـزِ والكَسَلِ والبُخْـلِ والجُـبْنِ، وضَلْـعِ الـدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَـةِ الرِّجال
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/158. See also Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/173.

duas.ar: لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظـيمُ الْحَلِـيمْ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَـرْشِ العَظِيـمِ، لَا إِلَـهَ إِلَّا اللَّهْ رَبُّ السَّمَـوّاتِ ورّبُّ الأَرْضِ ورَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَـريم
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 8/154, Muslim 4/2092

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ رَحْمَتَـكَ أَرْجـو فَلا تَكِلـني إِلى نَفْـسي طَـرْفَةَ عَـيْن، وَأَصْلِـحْ لي شَأْنـي كُلَّـه لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت
duas.en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42. Al-Albani graded it as good in Sahih Abu Dawud 
3/959.

duas.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت سُـبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْـتُ مِنَ الظّـالِميـن
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Al-Hakim declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 
with him 1/ 505. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/168.

duas.ar: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لا أُشْـرِكُ بِهِ شَيْـئاً
duas.en: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/87. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Mdjah 2/335.

duas.book_name_en: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنا نَجْـعَلُكَ في نُحـورِهِـم، وَنَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرورِهـمْ
duas.en: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/89, and Al-Hakim graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 
2/142.

duas.book_name_en: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُـدي، وَأَنْتَ نَصـيري، بِكَ أَجـولُ وَبِكَ أَصـولُ وَبِكَ أُقـاتِل
duas.en: O Allah, You are my strength and You are my support. For Your sake, I go forth and for Your sake, I advance and for Your sake, I fight.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 3/42, At-Tirmidhi 5/572. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 
3/183.

duas.book_name_en: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
duas.ar: حَسْبُـنا اللهُ وَنِعْـمَ الوَكـيل
duas.en: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, 5/172.

duas.book_name_en: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage, and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad (no. 707). Al-Albani graded it authentic in 
Sahih Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad (no. 545).

duas.book_name_en: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice
duas.ar: الله أكبر، الله أعز من خلقه جميعاً ، الله أعز مما أخاف وأحذر ، أعوذ بالله الذي لا إله إلا هو ، الممسك السموات السبع أن يقعن على الأرض إلا بإذنه ، من شر عبدك فلان ، وجنوده وأتباعه وأشياعه ، من الجن والأنس ، اللهم كن لي جاراً من شرهم ، جل ثناؤك وعز جارك ، وتبارك اسمك ، ولا إله غيرك (ثلاث مرات)
duas.en: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers, and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic.)
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, 5/172.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَاب سَرِيعَ الْحِسَاب اهْزِم الأَحْزَاب اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْهُم
duas.en: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/1362.

duas.book_name_en: When being afraid of a group of people
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِم بمَا شِئْت
duas.en: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2300.

duas.book_name_en: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء من أصابه شك في الإيمان
duas.ar: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ. يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ.
duas.en: (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/336, Muslim 1/120.

duas.book_name_en: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء من أصابه شك في الإيمان
duas.ar: يقول" آمنت بالله ورسله"
duas.en: (Say:) I believe in Allah and His Messengers.

duas.book_name_en: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء من أصابه شك في الإيمان
duas.ar: يقرأ قوله تعالى ((هُوَ الأوَّلُ، وَالآخِـرُ، وَالظّـاهِـرُ، وَالْبـاطِـنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَلـيم))
duas.en: (Recite the Ayat) He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things (in Arabic).
duas.reference:
Al-Hadid 57:3, Abu Dawud 4/329. Al-Albani graded it good in SahihAbu Dawud, 
3/962.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ اكْفِـني بِحَلالِـكَ عَنْ حَـرامِـك، وَأَغْنِـني بِفَضْـلِكَ عَمَّـنْ سِـواك
duas.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/560. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/180.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.en: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/158.

duas.book_name_en: For one afflicted by whisperings in prayer or recitation
duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً)
duas.en: (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast (then blow with a little spittle to your left). (Do this three times reciting in Arabic.)
duas.reference: Muslim 4/1729.

duas.book_name_en: For one whose affairs have become difficult
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
duas.en: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If You please You ease sorrow.
duas.reference:
Ibn Hibban in his Sahih (no. 2427), and Ibn As- Sunni (no. 351). Al-Hafidh 
(Ibn Hajar) said that this Hadith is authentic. It was also declared 
authentic by 'Abdul-Qadir Al-Arna'ut in his checking of An-Nawawi's 
Kitabul-Athkarp. 106.

duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنباً
duas.ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
duas.en: There is not any slave of Allah who commits a sin, then he perfects his purification and stands to pray two Rak'ahs of prayer, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, except that Allah will forgive him.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/86, At-Tirmidhi 2/257. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih 
Abu Dawud 1/283.

duas.book_name_en: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
duas.ar: الاستعاذة بالله منه
duas.en: Seeking refuge with Allah against him (i.e. by saying I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast).
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 1/206, At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/77, 
and Surat Al-Mu'minun, 23:98-9.

duas.book_name_en: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
duas.ar: الْأَذَانُ
duas.en: The call to prayer - 'Athan.
duas.reference: Muslim 1/291, Al-Bukhari 1/151.

duas.book_name_en: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
duas.ar: الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ
duas.en: Saying words of Allah's remembrance (Thikr) and recitation of the Qur'an.
duas.reference:
"Do not turn your homes into graveyards, surely the Devil flees from the 
house in which Surat Al-Baqarah is read," Muslim 1/539. The Devil is also 
driven out by the invocations for morning and evening, those that are said 
before sleeping and upon waking up, those for entering and leaving the 
house, including those for entering and leaving the mosque, and by many 
other authentic invocations taught to us by the Prophet (ﷺ) such as the 
reading of 'Ayatul-Kursi, (Al-Baqarah 2:255), and the last two 'Ayat of 
Surat Al-Baqarah before going to sleep. Whoever says: "There is none worthy 
of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and His 
is the praise, and he is Able to do all things," one hundred times, it will 
be a protection for him from the Devil throughout the day.'

duas.book_name_en: When stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء حينما يقع مالا يرضاه أو غلب على أمره
duas.ar: قَدَّرَ اللهُ وَما شـاءَ فَعَـل
duas.en: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
duas.reference:
"The strong believer is better and more dear to Allah than the weak 
believer, and in each of them there is good. Be vigilant for what is to 
your benefit and seek the help of Allah and do not falter. But when you are 
striken by some setback, do not say: 'If only I had done such and such,' 
rather say: 'It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.' For 
verily the saying 'if (i.e. if only I had) begins the work of the Devil." 
Muslim 4/2052.

duas.book_name_en: Congratulation on the occasion of a birth and its reply
duas.ar: (بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ). وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَــــــنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: (بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ).
duas.en: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
duas.reference:
An-Nawawi, Kitdbul-'Athkarp. 349, and Sahihul-'Athkar2/7l3 by Saleem 
Al-Hilali.

duas.ar: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعوذ الحسن والحسين " أعيذكما بكلمات الله التامة ، من كل شيطان وهامة ، ومن كل عينِ لامة "
duas.en: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari4/119.

duas.ar: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
duas.en: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani Fathul-Bari 10/118.

duas.ar: أَسْـأَلُ اللهَ العَـظيـم، رَبَّ العَـرْشِ العَـظيـم أَنْ يَشْفـيك . (سبع مرات)
duas.en: I ask Almighty Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to make you well. (Recite seven times in Arabic .)
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/210 and 
Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/180.

duas.ar: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)
duas.en: When a man goes to visit his sick Muslim brother, he walks along a path of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is cloaked in mercy. If he comes in the morning, seventy thousand angels pray for him until evening, and if he comes in the evening, seventy thousand angels pray for him until morning.

duas.book_name_en: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
duas.ar: أللّهُـمَّ اغْفِـرْ لي وَارْحَمْـني وَأَلْحِقْـني بِالرَّفـيقِ الأّعْلـى
duas.en: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me, and join me with the highest companions (in Paradise).
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari7/10, Muslim 4/1893.

duas.book_name_en: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
duas.ar: جعل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عند موته يدخل يديه في الماء فيمسح بهما وجههُ ويقول : لا إله إلا الله إن للموت لسكرات
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, surely death has agonies.
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/144. The Hadith also mention him 
using the Siivak (tooth stick).

duas.book_name_en: When the sick have renounced all hope of life
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
duas.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَاللّهُ أَكْبَـر، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحْـدَهُ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحْـدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْد، لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَلا حَـوْلَ وَلا قُـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِالله
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/152 and 
Sahih Ibn Majah 2/317.

duas.book_name_en: Instruction for the one nearing death
duas.book_name_ar: تلقين المحتضر لا إله إلا الله
duas.ar: من كان آخر كلامه "لا إله إلا الله" دخل الجنة
duas.en: Whoever dies with the last words (whose meaning is): "There is none worthy of worship but Allah" will enter Paradise.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3/190. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/432.

duas.book_name_en: For one afflicted by a calamity
duas.ar: إِنّا للهِ وَإِنَا إِلَـيْهِ راجِعـون ، اللهُـمِّ اْجُـرْني في مُصـيبَتي، وَاخْلُـفْ لي خَيْـراً مِنْـها
duas.en: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/632.

duas.book_name_en: When closing the eyes of the deceased
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لِـفلان (باسـمه) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَـهُ في المَهْـدِييـن ، وَاخْـلُفْـهُ في عَقِـبِهِ في الغابِـرين، وَاغْفِـرْ لَنـا وَلَـهُ يا رَبَّ العـالَمـين، وَافْسَـحْ لَهُ في قَبْـرِهِ وَنَـوِّرْ لَهُ فيه
duas.en: O Allah, forgive [name of the person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave, and shed light upon him in it.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/634.

duas.book_name_en: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْـه ، وَعافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْـه ، وَأَكْـرِمْ نُزُلَـه ، وَوَسِّـعْ مُدْخَـلَه ، وَاغْسِلْـهُ بِالْمـاءِ وَالثَّـلْجِ وَالْبَـرَدْ ، وَنَقِّـهِ مِنَ الْخطـايا كَما نَـقّيْتَ الـثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَـضَ مِنَ الدَّنَـسْ ، وَأَبْـدِلْهُ داراً خَـيْراً مِنْ دارِه ، وَأَهْلاً خَـيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِـه ، وَزَوْجَـاً خَـيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِه ، وَأَدْخِـلْهُ الْجَـنَّة ، وَأَعِـذْهُ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر [وَعَذابِ النّـار]
duas.en: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him, and cause his entrance to be wide, and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family, and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].
duas.reference: Muslim 2/663.

duas.book_name_en: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ اغْفِـرْ لِحَيِّـنا وَمَيِّتِـنا، وَشـاهِدِنا وَغائِبِـنا ، وَصَغيـرِنا وَكَبيـرِنا ، وَذَكَـرِنا وَأُنْثـانا . اللهُـمِّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْـتَهُ مِنّا فَأَحْيِـهِ عَلى الإِسْلام ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّـيْتَهُ مِنّا فَتَوَفَّـهُ عَلى الإِيـمان ، اللهُـمِّ لا تَحْـرِمْنـا أَجْـرَه ، وَلا تُضِـلَّنا بَعْـدَه
duas.en: O Allah forgive our living and our dead, those who are with us and those who are absent, our young and our old, our menfolk and our womenfolk. O Allah, whomever you give life from among us give him life in Islam, and whomever you take away from us take him away in Faith. O Allah, do not forbid us their reward and do not send us astray after them.
duas.reference: Ibn Majah 1/480, Ahmad 2/368. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/251.

duas.book_name_en: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ إِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فُلانٍ في ذِمَّـتِك ، وَحَبْـلِ جِـوارِك ، فَقِـهِ مِنْ فِتْـنَةِ الْقَـبْرِ وَعَذابِ النّـار ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفـاءِ وَالْـحَقِّ ، فَاغْفِـرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْـهُ ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَـفورُ الـرَّحيم
duas.en: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
duas.reference: Ibn Majah, Abu Dawud 3/211. See also Al Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/251.

duas.book_name_en: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ عَبْـدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَـتِك، احْتـاجَ إِلى رَحْمَـتِك، وَأَنْتَ غَنِـيٌّ عَنْ عَذابِـه، إِنْ كانَ مُحْـسِناً فَزِدْ في حَسَـناتِه، وَإِنْ كانَ مُسـيئاً فَتَـجاوَزْ عَنْـه
duas.en: O Allah, Your male slave and the child of Your female slave is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of his torment. If he was pious then increase his rewards and if he was a transgressor then pardon him.
duas.reference:
Al-Hakim 1/359 who graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him. See 
also Al-Albani, Ahkamul-Jana'iz, p. 125.

duas.book_name_en: When the deceased is a child, during the funeral prayer
duas.ar: "اللهم أعذه من عذاب القبر " وإن قال: "اللهم اجعله فرطاً وذخراً لوالديه ، وشفيعاً مجاباً . اللهم ثقل به موازينها وأعظم به أجورهما ، وألحقهُ بصالح المؤمنين ، واجعلهُ في كفالة إبراهيم ، وقه برحمتك عذاب الجحيم ، وأبدله داراً خيراً من داره ، وأهلاً خيراً من أهله ، اللهم اغفر لاسلافنا ، وأفراطنا ، ومن سبقنا بالإيمان " فحسن
duas.en: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave. [It is also good to say:] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home, and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
duas.reference:
Ibn Qudamah, Al-Mughni 3/416 and Ad-Duroosul-Muhimmah li-Aammatil-'Ummah, 
pg. 15, by Shaikh 'Abdul-'Aziz bin Baz.

duas.book_name_en: When the deceased is a child, during the funeral prayer
duas.ar: اللهُـمِّ اجْعَلْـهُ لَنا فَرَطـاً، وَسَلَـفاً وَأَجْـراً
duas.en: O Allah, make him for us a precursor, a forerunner and a cause of reward.
duas.reference: Al-Hasan (Al-Basri) used to recite Surat Al-Fatihah for a child's funeral and then say this. Al-Bukhari, Kitabul-Jana'iz, p. 65.

duas.ar: "إن لله ما أخذ وله ما أعطى . وكل شيء عنده بأجل مُسمى ... فلتصبر ولتحتسب " وإن قال : "أعظم الله أجرك ، وأحسن عزاءك وغفر لميتك" فحسن
duas.en: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time... so have patience and be rewarded.1 May Allah magnify your reward, and make perfect your bereavement, and forgive your departed.2
duas.reference:
1 Al-Bukhari 2/80, Muslim 2/636.
2An-Nawawi, Kitabul-'Athkar, p. 126.

duas.book_name_en: Placing the deceased in the grave
duas.ar: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَعَلـى سُـنَّةِ رَسـولِ الله
duas.en: With the Name of Allah, and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 3/314 with an authentic chain. Ahmad also recorded it with the 
wording: With the Name of Allah, and according to the religion of the 
Messenger of Allah. Its chain is also authentic.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
duas.en: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him.
duas.reference:
The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stop after burying the dead and say to the 
people: "Ask Allah to forgive your brother and pray for him to be 
strengthened, for indeed he is now being questioned." Abu Dawud 3/315, and 
Al-Hakim 1/370 who graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed.

duas.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَـيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيارِ مِنَ المؤْمِنيـنَ وَالْمُسْلِمين، وَإِنّا إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ بِكُـمْ لاحِقـون، نَسْـاَلُ اللهَ لنـا وَلَكُـمْ العـافِيَة
duas.en: Peace be upon you, people of this abode, from among the believers and those who are Muslims, and we, by the Will of Allah, shall be joining you. [May Allah have mercy on the first of us and the last of us] I ask Allah to grant us and you well-being.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/671, Ibn Majah 1/494, the portion brackets is from Muslim 2/671.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, and seek refuge in You against its evil.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 4/326, Ibn Majah 2/1228. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 
2/305.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيهـا، وَخَيْـرَ ما اُرْسِلَـتْ بِه، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيهـا، وَشَـرِّ ما اُرْسِلَـتْ بِه
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, for the good of what it contains, and for the good of what is sent with it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of it, from the evil of what it contains, and from the evil that is sent with it.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/616, Al-Bukhari 4/76.

duas.ar: سُبْـحانَ الّذي يُسَبِّـحُ الـرَّعْدُ بِحَمْـدِهِ، وَالملائِكـةُ مِنْ خيـفَته
duas.en: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him.
duas.reference:
Whenever Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) would hear thunder, he would abandon all 
conversation and say this supplication. See Al-Muwatta' 2/992. It was 
graded authentic by Al-Albani as a statement of Abdullah bin Zubayr only.

duas.ar: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِـنا غَيْـثاً مُغيـثاً مَريئاً مُريـعاً، نافِعـاً غَيْـرَ ضار، عاجِـلاً غَـيْرَ آجِل
duas.en: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1/303. See also Al-Albani SahihAbu Dawud 1/216.

duas.ar: اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا، اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا، اللّهُمَّ أغِثْنـا
duas.en: O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/224, Muslim 2/613.

duas.ar: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبادَكَ وَبَهـائِمَك، وَانْشُـرْ رَحْمَـتَكَ وَأَحْيِي بَلَـدَكَ المَيِّـت
duas.en: O Allah, give water to Your slaves, and Your livestock, and spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1/305. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/218.

duas.ar: اللّهُمَّ صَيِّـباً نافِـعاً
duas.en: O Allah, (bring) beneficial rain clouds.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 2/518.

duas.ar: مُطِـرْنا بِفَضْـلِ اللهِ وَرَحْمَـتِه
duas.en: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/205, Muslim 1/83.

duas.ar: اللّهُمَّ حَوالَيْنا وَلا عَلَيْـنا، اللّهُمَّ عَلى الآكـامِ وَالظِّـراب، وَبُطـونِ الأوْدِية، وَمَنـابِتِ الشَّجـر
duas.en: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys, and the roots of trees.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/224, Muslim 1/614

duas.ar: اللهُ أَكْـبَر، اللّهُمَّ أَهِلَّـهُ عَلَيْـنا بِالأمْـنِ وَالإيمـان، والسَّلامَـةِ والإسْلام، وَالتَّـوْفيـقِ لِما تُحِـبُّ رَبَّنـا وَتَـرْضـى، رَبُّنـا وَرَبُّكَ الله
duas.en: Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, bring us the new moon with security and Faith, with peace and in Islam, and in harmony with what our Lord loves and what pleases Him. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/504, Ad-Darimi 1/336. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 
3/157.

duas.ar: ذَهَـبَ الظَّمَـأُ، وَابْتَلَّـتِ العُـروق، وَثَبَـتَ الأجْـرُ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
duas.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/306 and others. See also Al- Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 
4/209.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ بِرَحْمَـتِكَ الّتي وَسِـعَت كُلَّ شيء، أَنْ تَغْـفِرَ لي
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
duas.reference:
Ibn Majah 1/557 from a supplication of Abdullah bin 'Amr. Al-Hafidh graded 
it as good in his checking of An-Nawawi's Kitabul-'Athkdr. See Sharhul- 
Athkar 4/342.

duas.ar: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.en: When anyone of you begins eating, say: With the Name of Allah. And if you forget then, when you remember, say: With the Name of Allah, in the beginning, and in the end.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 3/347, At-Tirmidhi 4/288. See Al- Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 
2/167.

duas.ar: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ"، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ "اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ"
duas.en: Whomever Allah has given food, should say: O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say : O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/506. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/158.

duas.ar: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الَّذي أَطْعَمَنـي هـذا وَرَزَقَنـيهِ مِنْ غَـيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلا قُوَّة
duas.en: Praise is to Allah Who has given me this food, and sustained me with it though I was unable to do it and powerless.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, and Ibn Majah. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 3/159.

duas.ar: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ حَمْـداً كَثـيراً طَيِّـباً مُبـارَكاً فيه، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلا مُسْتَغْـنىً عَنْـهُ رَبَّـنا
duas.en: All praise is to Allah, praise in abundance, good and blessed. It cannot [be compensated for, nor can it] be left, nor can it be done without, our Lord.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 6/214, At-Tirmidhi 5/507.

duas.book_name_en: Of the guest for the host
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ بارِكْ لَهُمْ فيما رَزَقْـتَهُم، وَاغْفِـرْ لَهُـمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.en: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/1615.

duas.book_name_en: To one who intends to give food or drink
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء إذا أراد الطعام أو الشراب
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سقاني
duas.en: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/126.

duas.book_name_en: When breaking fast in someones home
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت
duas.ar: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة
duas.en: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 296-8. 
Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730.

duas.book_name_en: By one fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر
duas.ar: (إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
duas.en: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/1054.

duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول الصائم إذا سابه أحد
duas.ar: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
duas.en: I am fasting. I am fasting.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-BAri 4/103, Muslim 2/806.

duas.book_name_en: Upon seeing the early or premature fruit
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ بارِكْ لَنا في ثَمَـرِنا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في مَدينَتِنـا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في صاعِنـا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في مُدِّنا
duas.en: O Allah, bless us in our dates and bless us in our town, bless us in our Sa' and in our Mudd.
duas.reference:
Muslim 2/1000 (Sa' and Mudd are both dry measures used for agricultural 
produce by the Arabs in the Prophet's time. Of the two, the So.' was the 
larger measure.) (Translator)

duas.ar: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: (يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: (يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَلْيَقُلْ: (يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)
duas.en: When you sneeze, then say: All praises and thanks are to Allah. Your companion should say: May Allah have mercy upon you. When someone says Yarḥamukallāh to you then you should say: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/125.

duas.book_name_en: When a disbeliever praises Allah after sneezing
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقالُ للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله
duas.ar: يَهْـديكُـمُ اللهُ وَيُصْـلِحُ بالَـكُم
duas.en: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/82, Ahmad 4/400, Abu Dawud 4/ 308. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 2/354.

duas.ar: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر
duas.en: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 
1/316.

duas.book_name_en: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.book_name_ar:
دعاء المتزوج 
 لنفسه ودعاء شراء الدابة
duas.ar: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ)، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
duas.en: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say : O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her. If you purchase a camel then take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/248 and Ibn Majah 1/617. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 
1/324.

duas.book_name_en: Before sexual intercourse with the wife
duas.ar: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ جَنِّبْنا الشَّيْـطانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّـيْطانَ ما رَزَقْـتَنا
duas.en: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Devil away from us, and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 6/141, Muslim 2/1028.

duas.ar: أَعـوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْـطانِ الرَّجيـم
duas.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/99, Muslim 4/2015.

duas.book_name_en: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
duas.ar: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الّذي عافاني مِمّا ابْتَـلاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَـني عَلى كَثيـرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَـقَ تَفْضـيلا
duas.en: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/493,4. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

duas.ar: عن ابن عمر قال : كان يعد لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة من قبل أن يقوم "رب اغفر لي وتب علي إنك أنت التواب الغفور"
duas.en: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting: My Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
duas.reference: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/321. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

duas.book_name_en: For the expiation of sins, said at the conclusion of a sitting or gathering
duas.ar: سُبْحـانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ وَبِحَمدِك، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَـيْك
duas.en: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa-bi-ḥamdik, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa-atūbu ilayk.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi and An-Nasa'i. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 3/ 153. Aishah (RA) said: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not sit 
in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any 
prayer without concluding by saying ... (then she quoted the above)." This 
was reported by An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (no.308), and Dr. 
Farooq Hamadah graded it authentic in his checking of the same book, p. 
273. See also Ahmad 6/77

duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك
duas.ar: وَلَكَ
duas.en: And you.
duas.reference:
Ahmad 5/82, and An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 218, with checking 
by Dr. Farooq Hamadah.

duas.book_name_en: To one who does you a favour
duas.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَـيْراً
duas.en: May Allah reward you with good.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi (no. 2035). See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/200 and 
Sahihul-Jami' (no. 6244).

duas.book_name_ar: الذكر الذي يعصم الله به من الدجال
duas.ar: .(مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.en: Whoever memorizes ten 'Ayat (Verses) from the beginning of Surat Al-Kahf, will be protected from the False Messiah 1 if he recites in every prayer after the final Tashahhud before ending the prayer, seeking the protection of Allah from the trials of the False Messiah.
duas.reference:
1 Muslim 1/555, another version mentions the last ten 'Ayat, Muslim 1/556.
2 See invocations no. 55 and 56 of this book.

duas.book_name_en: To one who pronounces his love for you, for Allahs sake
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله
duas.ar: أَحَبَّـكَ الّذي أَحْبَبْـتَني لَه
duas.en: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/333. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/965.

duas.book_name_en: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
duas.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك
duas.en: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.
duas.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-BAri 4/88.

duas.book_name_en: To the debtor when his debt is settled
duas.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك، إِنَّما جَـزاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ والأَداء
duas.en: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
duas.reference:
An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylahp. 300, Ibn Majah 2/809. See also 
Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah2/55.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْـرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنا أَعْـلَمْ، وَأَسْتَـغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أَعْـلَم
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
duas.reference:
Ahmad 4/403. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 3/233 and 
Sahihut-Targhib wat- Tarhib 1/19.

duas.book_name_en: To someone who says "May Allah bless you"
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك
duas.ar: وَفيكَ بارَكَ الله
duas.en: And may Allah bless you.
duas.reference:
Ibn As-Sunni, p. 138, (no. 278). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Al-Wdbil 
As-Sayyib, p. 304, with checking by Basheer Muhammad ?Uyoon.

duas.book_name_en: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens
duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ لا طَيْـرَ إِلاّ طَيْـرُك، وَلا خَـيْرَ إِلاّ خَـيْرُك، وَلا إِلهَ غَيْـرُك
duas.en: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You.
duas.reference:
Ahmad 2/220, Ibn As-Sunni (no. 292). See also Al-Albani, 
Silsilatul-'Ahadlth As-Sahihah 3/54, (no. 1065). As for bodings of good, 
these used to please the Prophet (ﷺ) and so when he heard good words from 
someone, he used to say: "We have taken from you a good portent from your 
mouth," Abu Dawud, Ahmad. See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadith 
As-Sahihah 2/363, and it is with Abu Ash-Shaikh Al-Asfahani in 
'Akhlaqun-Nabiyy, pg. 270.

duas.book_name_en: When mounting an animal or any means of transport
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء ركوب الدابة أو ما يقوم مقامها
duas.ar: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْـدُ لله، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، سُـبْحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ إِنّي ظَلَـمْتُ نَفْسي فَاغْـفِرْ لي، فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِـرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاّ أَنْـت
duas.en: With the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord, we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 3/34, At-Tirmidhi 5/501. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi3/156.

duas.ar: "اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ"، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: "آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ".
duas.en: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the One in Whose care we leave our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from this journey's hardships, and from the wicked sights in store and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning. (Upon returning recite the same again adding :) We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/978.

duas.book_name_en: Upon entering a town or village
duas.ar: أللّـهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّـمواتِ السّـبْعِ وَما أَظْلَلَـن، وَرَبَّ الأَراضيـنَ السّـبْعِ وَما أقْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الشَّيـاطينِ وَما أَضْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الرِّياحِ وَما ذَرَيْـن، أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَ هذهِ الْقَـرْيَةِ وَخَيْـرَ أَهْلِـها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها وَشَـرِّ أَهْلِـها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيها
duas.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town, and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people, and from the evil it contains.
duas.reference:
Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Tfaahabi agreed 2/100, and Ibn 
As-Sunni (no. 524). Al-Hafidh graded it good in his checking of Al-'Athkdr 
5/154. Ibn Baz said in Tuhfatul-'Akhydr p. 37, that An-Nasa'i recorded it 
with a good chain of narration.

duas.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْـكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، يُحْيـي وَيُميـتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لا يَمـوت، بِيَـدِهِ الْخَـيْرُ وَهوَ على كلّ شيءٍ قدير
duas.en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/291, and Al-Hakim 1/538. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih 
Ibn Majah 2/21 and Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/152.

duas.book_name_en: When the mounted animal (or mean of transport) stumbles
duas.ar: بِسْـمِ اللهِ
duas.en: With the Name of Allah.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/296. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/941.

duas.book_name_en: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
duas.ar: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه
duas.en: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
duas.reference: Ahmad 2/403, Ibn Majah 2/943. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133.

duas.book_name_en: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.ar: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك
duas.en: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
duas.reference: Ahmad 2/7, At-Tirmidhi 5/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/155.

duas.book_name_en: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.ar: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التقْوى، وَغَفَـرَذَنْـبَكَ، وَيَسَّـرَ لَكَ الخَـيْرَ حَيْـثُما كُنْـت
duas.en: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi. See Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi, 3/155.

duas.ar: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: (كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)
duas.en: Jabir (ra), said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subḥānallāh (Glory is to Allah).
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/135.

duas.book_name_en: Prayer of the traveller as dawn approaches
duas.ar: سَمِـعَ سـامِعٌ بِحَمْـدِ اللهِ وَحُسْـنِ بَلائِـهِ عَلَيْـنا. رَبَّنـا صـاحِبْـنا وَأَفْـضِل عَلَيْـنا عائِذاً باللهِ مِنَ النّـار
duas.en: He Who listens has heard that we praise Allah for the good things He gives us. Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek the protection of Allah from the Fire.
duas.reference:
Muslim 4/2086, the meaning of sami`a sāmi`un (who listens has heard) is 
that 'a witness has witnessed our praise of Allah due to His blessings and 
favor upon us.' It could also be read samma`a sāmi`un, in which case it 
means 'one who has heard this statement of mine will convey it to another 
and he will say it as well.' This is due to the attention given to the 
Thikr (remembrance of Allah) and supplications made during the early 
morning hours. The meaning of his saying 'Our Lord, be with us and bestow 
Your favor upon us' is: 'Our Lord, protect us and guard us. Bless us with 
Your numerous bounties, and avert from us every evil.' See An-Nawawi, Sharh 
Sahih Muslim 17/39.

duas.book_name_en: Stopping or lodging somewhere in travel and otherwise
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء إذا نزل منزلا في سفر أو غيره
duas.ar: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِـماتِ اللّهِ التّـامّاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق
duas.en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2080.

duas.ar: يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
duas.en: From every elevated point say Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) three times and then recite: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord. He fulfilled His Promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated the Confederates.
duas.reference:
Bukhari 7/163, Muslim 2/980. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this when 
returning from a campaign or from Hajj.

duas.book_name_en: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه
duas.ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)
duas.en: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.reference:
Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 
1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays for Allah's blessings upon me once, will be blessed for it by Allah ten times."
duas.reference: Muslim 1/288.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not make my grave a place of ritual celebration, but pray for Allah's blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me from wherever you are.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/218, Ahmad 2/367. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu 
Dawud 2/383.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned yet does not pray for Allah's blessings upon me."
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/551 and others. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/177 
and Sahihul-Jarai' As-Saghir 3/25.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:(إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my Ummah (nation)."
duas.reference:
An-Nasa'i, Al-Hakim 2/421. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih An-Nasa'i 
1/274.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings."
duas.reference: Abu Dawud (no. 2041). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/383.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "You shall not enter Paradise until you believe, and you have not believed until you love one another. Shall I tell you of something you can do to make you love one another? Spread the greetings of Salam (peace) amongst yourselves (i.e. between each other).
duas.reference: Muslim 1/74 and others.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.ar: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ
duas.en: Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/82 as a statement of the 
Companion 'Ammar (RA).

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: (تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)
duas.en: `Abdullah bin `Umar (RA) said: A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ), "What is the best act of Islam?" He said, "To feed others and to give greetings of Salam (peace) to those whom you know and to those whom you do not know. "
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/55, Muslim 1/65.

duas.book_name_en: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
duas.book_name_ar: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم
duas.ar: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
duas.en: If one of the People of the Scripture (i.e. Christians and Jews) greets you saying As-Salaamu `alaykum, then say (to him): And upon you .
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/42, Muslim 4/1705.

duas.book_name_en: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء عند سماع صياح الديك ونهيق الحمار
duas.ar: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً
duas.en: When you hear the cock's crow, ask Allah for His favor upon you for surely it has seen an angel. When you hear the bray of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for surely it has seen a devil.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/350, Muslim 4/2092.

duas.book_name_en: Upon hearing the barking of dogs at night
duas.book_name_ar: دعاء عند سماع نباح الكلاب بالليل
duas.ar: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ
duas.en: When you hear a dog barking or a donkey braying in the night, then seek refuge in Allah from them, for surely they have seen what you see not.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 4/327, Ahmad 3/306. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu 
Dawud 3/961.

duas.ar: قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: "اللَّهُم فأيما مؤمن سببته فاجعل ذلك له قربة إليك يوم القيامة"
duas.en: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, give him the reward of a sacrificial slaughter for it on the Day of Resurrection.
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/171, Muslim 4/2007. The wording 
in Muslim's report is: 'make it a purification for him and a source of 
mercy.

duas.book_name_en: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول المسلم إذا مدح المسلم
duas.ar: قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا"
duas.en: If any of you praises his companion then let him say: I consider (such and such a person), and Allah is his Assessor, (meaning: and I cannot claim anyone to be pious before Allah) if you know of this (good character trait in the person) to be such and such (saying what he thinks is praiseworthy in that person).
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2296.

duas.book_name_en: For the one that have been praised
duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
duas.en: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adabul-Mufrad no. 761. See Al-Albani, Sahih 
Al-'Adabul-Mufrad (no. 585). The portion between brackets if from 
Al-Bayhaqi, Shu'ab Al-Iman 4/228, and comes another account.

duas.book_name_en: The Talbiya for the one doing Hajj or 'Umrah
duas.book_name_ar: كيف يلبي المحرم في الحج أو العمرة
duas.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ والنِّعْمَة لَكَ والمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.en: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partner, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk. Innal-ḥamda wan-niʿmata laka wal-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/408, Muslim 2/841.

duas.book_name_en: The Takbîr passing the black stone
duas.ar: طَافَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf riding a camel. Every time he passed the corner (containing the Black Stone), he would point to it with something that he was holding and say: Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great)!
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/476. See also 472. The 
'something' that was referred to in this Hadith was a cane.

duas.book_name_en: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
duas.book_name_ar: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود
duas.ar: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حسَنةً وقِنَا عذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
duas.en: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/179, Ahmad 3/411, Al-Baghawi, Sharhus-Sunnah 7/128. Al-Albani 
graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/354. The Ayat is from Surat Al-Baqarah, 
2:201.

duas.book_name_en: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
duas.ar: (لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ "أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ" فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذلكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ) الْحَدِيثُ. وَفِيهِ: (فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)
duas.en: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) approached Mount Safa, he would recite: Surely Safa and Marwah are among the signs of Allah. I begin by that which Allah began. He began (his Sa'y) at Mount Safa climbing it until he could see the House. He then faced the Qiblah repeating the words: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great. Then he said: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He fulfilled His Promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated Confederates. Then he would ask Allah for what he liked, repeating the same thing like this three times. He did at Mount Marwah as he did at Mount Safa.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/888.

duas.ar: خير الدعاء دعاء يوم عرفة ، وخيرُ ما قلت أنا والنبيُّون من قبلي : لا إله إلا الله وحدهُ لا شريك لهُ ، لهُ الملكُ ولهُ الحمدُ وهو على كل شيء قدير.
duas.en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/184, and also 
Silsilatul-'Ahadith As-Sahihah 4/6.

duas.ar: رَكِبَ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
duas.en: 'He (ﷺ) rode Al-Qaswa until he reached Al-MashAAar Al-Haram, he then faced the qiblah, supplicated to Allah, and extoled His greatness and oneness. He stood until the sun shone but left before it rose.'
duas.reference: Muslim 2/891.

duas.book_name_en: Takbir when throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
duas.book_name_ar: التكبير عند رمي الجمار مع كل حصاة
duas.ar: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillars. As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allāhu Akbar with every pebble he threw, but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/581, 3, 4, and Muslim

duas.book_name_en: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول عند التعجب والأمر السار
duas.ar: سُـبْحانَ الله
duas.en: (Glory is to Allah).
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/210, 390, 414 and Muslim 4/1857.

duas.book_name_en: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول عند التعجب والأمر السار
duas.ar: اللهُ أَكْـبَر
duas.en: (Allah is the Most Great)
duas.reference:
Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/441. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 2/103, 235, Ahmad 5/218.

duas.book_name_ar: ما يفعل من أتاه أمر يسره
duas.ar: كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ), upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure, would prostrate in gratitude to Allah blessed and exalted.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 
1/233, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/226.

duas.book_name_en: When feeling some pain in the body
duas.book_name_ar: ما يفعل ويقول من أحس وجعاً في جسده
duas.ar: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: "بِسْمِ اللَّهِ" ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: "أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ"
duas.en: Put your hand on the place where you feel pain and say: With the Name of Allah (three times). Then say seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and in His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I guard against.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/1728.

duas.book_name_en: When in fear of afflicting something with an (evil) eye from oneself
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول من خشي أن يصيب شيئاً بعينه
duas.ar: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ
duas.en: If you see something from your brother, yourself or wealth which you find impressing, then invoke blessings for it, for the evil eye is indeed true.
duas.reference:
Ahmad 4/447, Ibn Majah, Malik. Al-Albani graded it authentic in 
Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 1/212. Also see Al-Arna'ut's checking of Ibn 
Al-Qayyim's Zadul-Ma'ad 4/170.

duas.ar: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah!
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/181, Muslim 4/2208.

duas.book_name_en: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول عند الذبح أو النحر
duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.en: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/ 1557, Al-Bayhaqi 9/287.

duas.book_name_en: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils
duas.book_name_ar: ما يقول لرد كيد مردة الشياطين
duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولَا فَاجرٌ مِنْ شّرِّ مَا خَلقَ، وبَرَأَ وذَرَأَ، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وِمنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، ومِن شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ في الأَرْضِ ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وِمنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهارِ، ومِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
duas.en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah -which neither the upright nor the corrupt may overcome - from the evil of what He created, of what He made, and of what He scattered, from the evil of what descends from the heavens, and of what rises up to them, from the evil of what He scattered in the earth, and of what emerges from it, from the evil trials of night and day, and from the evil of every night visitor, except the night visitor who comes with good. O Merciful One.
duas.reference:
Ahmad 3/419, with an authentic chain of narration, and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 
637). Al-Arna'ut, graded its chain authentic in his checking of Al-'Aqidah 
At-Tahawiyyah p. 133. See also Majma'uz-Zawa'id, 10/127.

duas.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: "وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ"
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "By Allah, I seek the forgiveness of Allah, and repent to Him more than seventy times in a day.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/101.

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "O people, repent to Allah, for I verily repent to Him one hundred times a day.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2076.

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ)، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him, Allah will forgive him even if he has deserted the army's ranks.
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud 2/85, At-Tirmidhi 5/569, and Al-Hakim who declared it authentic 
and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/511. Al-Albani graded it authentic in 
Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182. See also Jami'ul-'Usool li-'Ahdaith Ar-Rasool 4/ 
389-90 checked by Al-Arna'ut.

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "The closest that the Lord comes to the slave is in the last portion of the night. So, if you are able to be among those who remember Allah in this hour, then be among them."
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasa'i 1/279 and Al-Hakim. See also Al-Albani, Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi 3/183, and Jdmi'ul-'Usool with Al-Arna'ut's checking 4/144.

duas.ar: .وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "The closest that the slave comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so invoke Allah much (in prostration)."
duas.reference: Muslim 1/350.

duas.ar: .وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "It is a heavy thing for my heart if I do not seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day."
duas.reference:
Muslim 4/2075. Ibn 'Athir explains that the Prophet (ﷺ) was always 
vigilant in his remembrance and drawing near to Allah, and if he forgot to 
do any of what he normally did from time to time, or it slipped his mind, 
he felt as if he had wronged himself and so he would begin to seek the 
forgiveness of Allah. See Jami'ul-'Usool 4/386.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ) فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: Glorified is Allah and praised is He. one hundred times a day, will have his sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2071, see also invocation no. 91 of this book.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. ten times, will have the reward for freeing four slaves from the Children of Isma'il.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/67, Muslim 4/2071, see also invocation no. 93 of this book.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)، (سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Two words are light on the tongue, weigh heavily in the balance, and are loved by the Most Merciful One: Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2072.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَأَنْ أَقُولَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ)، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: For me to say: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great. is dearer to me than all that the sun rises upon (i.e. the whole world).
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2072.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ.
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Is anyone of you incapable of earning one thousand Hasanah (rewards) in a day?" Someone from his gathering asked, "How can anyone of us earn a thousand Hasanah?" He said, "Glorify Allah a hundred times and a thousand Hasanah will be written for you, or a thousand sins will be wiped away."
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2073.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: مَنْ قَالَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ) غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
duas.en: Whoever says: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He. will have a date palm planted for him in Paradise.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/511, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi 
agreed 1/501. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/531 and Sahih 
At-Tirmidhi3/160.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قُلْ (لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "O Abdullah bin Qais, should I not point you to one of the treasures of Paradise?" I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." So he told me to say: There is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/213, Muslim 4/2076.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ)، وَ(الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَ(لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)، وَ(اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ)، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ
duas.en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The most beloved words to Allah are four: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah, and There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/1685.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: قُلْ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ). قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: قُلْ (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي).
duas.en: A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Teach me a word that I can say. " The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to say: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Who has no partner, Allah is the Great, the Most Great, and praise is to Allah in abundance, glory is to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no might but by Allah the Mighty, the Wise. He said, "That is for my Lord, but what about me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to say: O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me, and provide for me.
duas.reference:
Muslim 4/2072, Abu Dawud reports the same Hadith with the addition: and 
when the Arab left, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "He has filled his hands with 
goodness." 1/220.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)
duas.en: Whenever anyone accepted Islam, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach him how to pray then he would instruct him to invoke Allah with the following words: O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me and give me good health and provide for me.
duas.reference:
Muslim 4/2073, and in one of Muslim's reports there is the addition: 'For 
these words combine [the goodness of] this world and the next.'

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)
duas.en: The most excellent invocation is: Praise is for Allah. and the most excellent words of remembrance are: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
duas.reference:
At-Tirmidhi 5/462, Ibn Majah 2/1249, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 
and Ath-Tbahabi agreed 1/503. See Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 1/362.

duas.book_name_en: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.book_name_ar: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.ar: الباقيات الصالحات : (سبحان الله) و(الحمد لله )، و(لا إله إلا الله)، و(الله أكبر) ،و (لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله).
duas.en: The good deeds which endure are: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah, and There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great, and There is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.reference:
Ahmad (no. 513) (Ahmad Shakir, ed.) and its chain of narration is 
authentic. See Majma'uz-Zawa'id 1/297. Ibn Hajar mentions it in 
Bulughul-Maram saying that Ibn Hibban and Al-Hakim considered it authentic.

duas.book_name_en: How the Prophet (ﷺ) ﷺ made tasbeeh
duas.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنهما قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ بِيَمِينِهِ.
duas.en: Abdullah bin 'Amr (RA) said: "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) counting the glorification of his Lord on his right hand."
duas.reference:
Abu Dawud with a different wording 2/81, and At-Tirmidhi 5/521. See also 
Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami'As-Saghir 4/271 (no. 4865).

duas.book_name_en: Comprehensive types of good and manners
duas.ar: إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَـكُفُّوا صِبْيانَـكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ.
duas.en: When night falls, restrain your children (from going out) because at such time the devils spread about. After a period of time has passed, let them be. Shut your doors and mention Allah’s name, for verily the devil does not open a shut door, tie up your water-skins and mention Allah’s name, cover your vessels with anything and mention Allah’s name and put out your lamps.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari with Al-Fath 10/88 and Muslim 3/1595.
